chunks: Yaqub ibn Yazid from Ibn Abi Umayr from Hisham ibn al-Hakam from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) who said:
"There is no harm if a man prays when he stays overnight at Arafat."

key_terms.أَمْسَى: stayed overnight / remained in the evening
key_terms.بِعَرَفَةَ: at Arafat (the sacred site for Hajj)
key_terms.لاَ بَأْسَ: there is no harm / it is permissible

ai.seo_question: Is it permissible for a pilgrim to pray while staying overnight at Arafat?
ai.summary: Reported by Shaykh al-Tusi in *Tahdhib al-Ahkam*, this hadith clarifies the permissibility of performing prayers at Arafat during the evening stay (wuquf), a central pillar of Hajj. It reflects the practical flexibility granted to pilgrims in the sacred precincts, ensuring that ritual obligations are not unduly burdened by the location of the standing. This ruling is significant in Shia jurisprudence for distinguishing between the essential act of standing and the specific manner or timing of prayer within that context.
